output.reason: Localized itchy blistering rash on both forearms after reported poison ivy exposure, with no fever and no breathing trouble reported, fits self-care with over-the-counter measures and clear escalation triggers.
output.patientMessage: You can start self-care now: cool compresses, an over-the-counter hydrocortisone cream, and an over-the-counter antihistamine for itching; ask your pharmacist what suits you. This pattern fits poison ivy contact dermatitis. Message us or see a clinician if the rash spreads well beyond your forearms, involves your face or genitals, becomes painful, warm or pus-filled, or you develop fever; call 911 for trouble breathing or facial swelling.
differential: Allergic contact dermatitis from urushiol (poison ivy)
Secondary skin infection if lesions become painful, warm or purulent
